BOILER INSTALLATION · FIFE

A new boiler. A considered choice.

Grandison Plumbing & Heating handles boiler installation enquiries across Fife. The starting point is a system that suits your home and how you use it.

Discuss your project ↗See our work

PLAN THE WORK

Choose for your home, not just a model number.

Your hot-water demand, existing pipework and available space all influence the choice. A combi heats water on demand; a system boiler works with a hot-water cylinder; a regular boiler typically works with a cylinder and separate feed arrangements.

Frequent faults or changing household needs can make replacement worth discussing. Age alone does not settle the question. Compare the condition of the boiler, a repair estimate and the work involved in a replacement.

Ask what the quote includes: the appliance, any pipework or flue changes, controls, commissioning and handover. Confirm the manufacturer’s warranty terms for the specific appliance and installation.

Further reading: Energy Saving Trust: boiler types

THINGS TO DISCUSS

Make the brief clear.

  • Existing system and hot-water demand
  • Boiler position and flue requirements
  • Heating controls and system compatibility
  • Written installation scope and handover

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Which type of boiler is best?

That depends on your home, available space and hot-water demand. An assessment should come before a recommendation.

Can you give a price without a visit?

Photos and basic details can help an initial discussion, but a firm quote depends on the installation requirements.

Are other heating options worth considering?

When replacing a heating system, consider your longer-term plans too. Energy Saving Trust explains boiler types and lower-carbon alternatives.
